_help: The extra featured sections on the home page, below the main 'Featured books' slider (which is set in featured-slider-books.json).
Each section: a type ('author' or 'theme'), a heading, a short intro, and the book ids to show (the number at the start of a book's web address: /books/441-... is id 441).
For an 'author' section, 'author' must be the name exactly as shown on the site (see data/author-names.json); the intro line is then written from the catalogue automatically.
'placement' is where it goes: 'after-slider' or 'after-authors' (after 'Authors in our collection').

Every book needs an author, a cover, and a description from Google Books; the build stops with a clear message if one doesn't. Keep to 4 sections at most so the page stays short. The 'why' notes are just for people reading this file.

FEATURED AUTHORS: the row of large portraits on the home page, shown just before 'Authors in our collection'. List up to 6 names in 'featuredAuthors.authors', in order. Any spelling used in the catalogue works (e.g. 'Murtada Mutahhari' finds Murtaza Mutahhari); the build stops if a name has no author page. Authors without a free photo show a large initials panel.

sections.heading: New to Islamic beliefs? Start here
sections.intro: Short, clear introductions to the core beliefs of Shi'a Islam.
sections.why: The library's Theology shelf is strongest on these 'Usul al-Din' introductions, and five have real covers and Google Books descriptions.

sections.author: Murtaza Mutahhari
sections.why: The author with the most books in the library (31); 10 of them have covers and descriptions.

sections.author: Muhammad Baqir al-Sadr
sections.why: Third-largest author in the library; covers philosophy, belief, economics and law. (His 'Contemporary Man and the Social Problem' is already in the main slider.)

sections.heading: Building character
sections.intro: Books on knowing yourself and growing in good character.
sections.why: Five books on self-knowledge and ethics from the Philosophy and Fiqh shelves, all with covers and descriptions.
